pre_freeze_credit.finding: The commutation-at-birth study supplied the 1,177 eligible closures, proposed the exact pair-count maximum and already gave the odd ring case. The current study adds the closure-by-closure optima and comparison scores.

Four readings supplied the 173 finished types. The no-whole-state study measured rule R on them and reported 17 viable reached types, 12 odd and 5 even. Where the all-pairs word is feasible it is the unique pair-count maximum. The commutation-at-birth study already reported that all 173 types admit an odd complete choice.

prior_work.search_limit: The other full-text hits concern unrelated uses of similar terms or duplicate the planned study in A315 and the tracking dump. The search found a prior proposal, fixture and population, and no separate archive of the full optimum verdict counts.

gates_as_run.enumeration: The original implementation compared the global pair-count maximum and minimum weights and sign verdicts at the 386 grown closures of dimension at most 14. The comparison omits the holder-type score, the round-by-round score and sign-conditioned weights as distinct values (most_failing.py:333–337).
gates_as_run.order: One returned pair-count maximum per grown closure was read in complete reverse knot order (most_failing.py:284–288). Reversal preserves alternation even for a word that fails a commutation check. For two distinctions with occurrence word 0101 the reverse 1010 also alternates, while the adjacent swap to 1001 does not. The earlier adjacent-exchange argument proves full order invariance on the code (commutation-at-birth README:88–90).
gates_as_run.settlement: The archived gate tallies unsettled grown verdicts for the pair maximum, minimum nonzero and holder-type maximum (most_failing.py:344–345). The archived rows contain all three settled verdicts at 1,177 grown closures and 173 finished types, and no unsettled round-by-round row. One grown case and one finished type have an infeasible even nonzero minimum. These feasibility outcomes are distinct from solver timeouts.
gates_as_run.numeric_replay: This record check reads the archived gates and verdict fields. Independent numeric replay is reported separately.
